items.title: Antiplatelet Therapy and All-Cause Mortality After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement: The TRITAVI Registry
items.title_zh: TRITAVI登记研究:TAVR术后单一抗血小板治疗较双联治疗6个月全因死亡率更低(2.4%对5.4%),大出血减少近三分之二
items.summary_zh: TRITAVI登记研究纳入多中心共10,071例接受TAVR的患者,重点分析经股动脉入路人群中单一抗血小板治疗(SAPT)与双联抗血小板治疗(DAPT)的预后差异(此前在SCAI会议报告的亚组分析纳入5,514例,其中3,197例SAPT、2,317例DAPT)。结果显示,SAPT组6个月全因死亡率为2.4%,显著低于DAPT组的5.4%,大出血发生率SAPT组为0.5%,亦低于DAPT组的1.3%;校正后DAPT组6个月死亡风险增加(HR 1.69,95%CI 1.20-2.37),24个月死亡风险仍显著更高(HR 1.21,95%CI 1.01-1.46)。研究提示,在无需长期抗凝指征的TAVR患者中,单一抗血小板方案可能较双联方案带来更低的死亡与出血风险,但作者强调该结论来自观察性登记数据,仍需前瞻性随机证据证实。
items.summary_en: The multicenter TRITAVI registry analyzed 10,071 patients undergoing TAVR, with a focused comparison of single (SAPT) versus dual (DAPT) antiplatelet therapy in a femoral-access subgroup (a SCAI-presented subset included 5,514 patients: 3,197 on SAPT, 2,317 on DAPT). SAPT was associated with lower 6-month all-cause mortality (2.4% vs 5.4% with DAPT) and less major bleeding (0.5% vs 1.3%); after adjustment, DAPT carried a significantly higher 6-month mortality risk (HR 1.69, 95% CI 1.20-2.37) that persisted at 24 months (HR 1.21, 95% CI 1.01-1.46). The findings suggest single antiplatelet therapy may lower both death and bleeding risk compared with dual therapy in TAVR patients without an indication for long-term anticoagulation, though the authors caution this is observational registry evidence requiring prospective randomized confirmation.

items.title: Temporal Trends in Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Interventions After FDA Approval in the United States
items.title_zh: 美国FDA批准后经导管三尖瓣介入时间趋势:T-TEER月手术量两年增至156例,院内死亡率0.5%显著低于TTVR的2.0%
items.summary_zh: 一项基于美国全国住院患者数据的队列研究分析了FDA批准三尖瓣介入器械后,经导管三尖瓣缘对缘修复(T-TEER)与经导管三尖瓣置换(TTVR)的应用趋势。结果显示,T-TEER月手术量从2024年10月的128例增至2025年12月的156例,TTVR月手术量同期从60例增至111例,两种术式应用均快速增长。院内死亡率方面,T-TEER为0.5%,显著低于TTVR的2.0%;院内大出血发生率T-TEER为6.0%,亦低于TTVR的12.4%。研究提示,随着三尖瓣介入器械普及,T-TEER在短期安全性上仍优于创伤更大的TTVR,为临床术式选择提供真实世界参考。
items.summary_en: A U.S. national cohort analysis tracked adoption trends in transcatheter tricuspid edge-to-edge repair (T-TEER) and transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement (TTVR) following FDA approval of tricuspid devices. Monthly T-TEER volumes rose from 128 cases in October 2024 to 156 in December 2025, while TTVR volumes grew from 60 to 111 over the same period. In-hospital mortality was lower with T-TEER (0.5%) than TTVR (2.0%), and in-hospital major bleeding was likewise lower (6.0% vs 12.4%), offering real-world evidence to inform procedure selection as tricuspid device use expands.

items.title: Single TriClip Steerable Guide for Combined MitraClip and TriClip Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair (STriC-TEER): A Multicenter Experience
items.title_zh: STriC-TEER多中心经验:单根TriClip可调弯导引鞘完成MitraClip二尖瓣与TriClip三尖瓣联合缘对缘修复,40例患者免去中途换鞘
items.summary_zh: 一项来自香港、台湾、泰国与澳大利亚多中心的回顾性研究报告了STriC-TEER新技术:术者利用同一根TriClip可调弯导引鞘(SGC)先送入MitraClip系统完成二尖瓣缘对缘修复,再将鞘回撤至右心房后送入TriClip系统完成三尖瓣修复,免去传统术式中途更换导引鞘的步骤。该研究纳入2023-2025年间40例患者(平均年龄76.8±9.1岁,70%为男性,97.1%合并房颤),其中4例同期还接受了左心耳封堵。作者认为该一鞘两用策略安全可行,但强调仍需前瞻性随机对照研究,以比较其与传统换鞘策略在效率、结局及成本效益方面的差异。
items.summary_en: A multicenter retrospective study from Hong Kong, Taiwan, Thailand, and Australia reports STriC-TEER, a technique using a single TriClip steerable guide catheter (SGC) to deliver both the MitraClip system for mitral edge-to-edge repair and, after withdrawing the same guide into the right atrium, the TriClip system for tricuspid repair -- avoiding the catheter exchange required in conventional combined procedures. The series included 40 patients treated between 2023 and 2025 (mean age 76.8±9.1 years, 70% male, 97.1% with atrial fibrillation), four of whom also underwent concurrent left atrial appendage occlusion. The authors call the single-guide strategy safe and feasible, while noting that prospective randomized trials are needed to compare it with the conventional catheter-exchange approach for efficiency, outcomes, and cost-effectiveness.

items.title: LIRA Method in Bicuspid TAVI: Outcomes and Reproducibility
items.title_zh: LIRA测量法用于二叶式主动脉瓣TAVI多中心研究(215例):技术成功率97.2%,瓣膜尺寸选择一致性达kappa=0.85
items.summary_zh: 南美洲介入心脏病学会(SOLACI)于2026年10月6日报道了一项评估LIRA测量法(基于主动脉瓣raphe水平测量瓣环周长以指导瓣膜选型)在二叶式主动脉瓣(BAV)患者TAVI中应用的多中心回顾性研究。研究纳入2018-2025年间6家中心215例接受择期TAVI的症状性重度主动脉瓣狭窄合并二叶瓣患者。结果显示,技术成功率97.2%,器械成功率93%;与传统瓣环测量法相比,LIRA法在74.4%的病例中选择了更小尺寸的瓣膜(降尺寸);观察者间瓣膜尺寸选择一致性极佳(kappa=0.85,95%CI 0.74-0.96),瓣环周长测量一致性良好(ICC=0.76,95%CI 0.63-0.85)。30天卒中发生率1.9%,无术中或30天死亡。研究提示LIRA法在多中心应用中具有良好的重复性与临床结果,但作者同时指出,近期NOTION-2随机试验的结果对该类人群的某些结论提出了新的讨论。
items.summary_en: SOLACI (the Latin American Society of Interventional Cardiology) reported on October 6, 2026, a multicenter retrospective study evaluating the LIRA method -- which measures annular perimeter at the raphe level to guide prosthesis sizing -- in patients with bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) undergoing TAVI. The study included 215 patients with symptomatic severe aortic stenosis and bicuspid anatomy who underwent elective TAVI between 2018 and 2025 at six centers. Technical success was 97.2% and device success 93%; compared with standard annular sizing, the LIRA method led to selection of a smaller prosthesis (downsizing) in 74.4% of cases. Inter-observer agreement was excellent for prosthesis-size selection (kappa 0.85, 95% CI 0.74-0.96) and good for perimeter measurement (ICC 0.76, 95% CI 0.63-0.85). The 30-day stroke rate was 1.9%, with no procedural or 30-day deaths. The authors conclude the LIRA method shows good reproducibility and clinical outcomes across centers, while noting that the recent NOTION-2 randomized trial has raised new discussion around some conclusions in this population.

items.title: Simultaneous Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair (TEER) for Severe Mitral and Tricuspid Regurgitation Is Feasible, Safe, and Associated With Good Clinical Outcome
items.title_zh: 单中心40例联合二尖瓣三尖瓣缘对缘修复经验:联合手术成功率80%,术中零死亡/心梗/卒中,1年死亡率30%
items.summary_zh: 一项单中心回顾性研究分析了2019-2021年间40例同期接受二尖瓣与三尖瓣缘对缘修复(TEER)治疗重度二尖瓣反流(MR)合并重度三尖瓣反流(TR)患者的安全性与疗效。结果显示,联合手术成功(定义为MR降低≥2级且TR降低≥1级)达成率为80%,单纯二尖瓣修复成功率为92%;术中无一例死亡、心肌梗死、卒中或大出血。1年随访时患者症状明显改善,但全因死亡率为30%,心衰再住院率为35%;手术成功及残余MR≤1级与更低的1年死亡率相关,但未显著降低心衰再住院风险。作者认为联合TEER治疗双瓣反流安全有效,但该人群为2019-2021年早期经验,仍需随机对照试验进一步验证。
items.summary_en: A single-center retrospective study evaluated the safety and efficacy of combined mitral and tricuspid transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (TEER) in 40 patients with severe mitral regurgitation (MR) and severe tricuspid regurgitation (TR) treated between 2019 and 2021. Combined procedural success (MR reduction ≥2 grades and TR reduction ≥1 grade) was achieved in 80% of cases, with isolated mitral success in 92%; there were no intraprocedural deaths, myocardial infarctions, strokes, or major bleeding events. At 1 year, symptoms improved substantially, but all-cause mortality was 30% and heart-failure rehospitalization was 35%; procedural success and residual MR ≤1+ were associated with lower 1-year mortality but not with fewer heart-failure hospitalizations. The authors conclude combined TEER is feasible and safe for treating dual-valve regurgitation, while noting the 2019-2021 cohort reflects early experience and randomized trials are still needed.
